nodes.question: What is the significance of evaluating groundwater suitability for human consumption and agriculture?
nodes.answer: Evaluating groundwater suitability is crucial to ensure the sustainable use of this vital resource for human consumption and agriculture. By assessing the quality and availability of groundwater, we can make informed decisions to prevent depletion and contamination, ultimately safeguarding public health and food security.
